## Summary

Describe the user, operator, protocol, or supply-chain outcome.

## Validation

- [ ] Focused tests reproduce and cover the change.
- [ ] `make check` passes.
- [ ] `make coverage` passes.
- [ ] `git diff --check` passes.
- [ ] Runtime, E2E, SBOM, and scan gates were run when their surface changed.

## Compatibility and operations

- [ ] Protocol compatibility and negative behavior are covered.
- [ ] Operator documentation and migration impact are current.
- [ ] No credentials, real account data, generated local artifacts, or unrelated WIP are included.
